title: Food Bought outside Tailwise Autoship and Shared Household Food Spacing
content:
**Orders desk note — one-time food purchases**

Food bought outside the Autoship shortens the days between shipments of a shared household food Autoship under Tailwise Autoship (a non-prescription food subscription that feeds more than one pet of the household). The purchases are read from the customer's Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders records: one-time order lines of food charged to the customer.

| One-time order lines of food charged to the customer in the last 2 months | Days taken away |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 6 |
| exactly 1 | 3 |
| none | none |

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

Lines are counted one by one: one order carrying two charged food lines counts as two. Lines of items other than food do not count.

**Hypothetical record.** One food line charged three weeks ago: 3 days taken away. One charged exactly 2 months before the day the value is worked out: it does not count.
